landing.headline: See the outbreak before it spreads.
landing.sub: Report a sick animal in your own language in under two minutes — get instant, explainable triage while district officers watch the live risk map.
landing.disclaimer: Preliminary triage, not a diagnosis — always consult a veterinarian.

dashboard.heading: Dashboard
dashboard.heroTitle: Field reports, triage and live risk — one bridge.
dashboard.heroSub: PashuSetu links farmers, paravets, vets and district officers on one real-time animal health network.
dashboard.emptyBody: Overview stats, the live map and recent reports will appear here as parts are built.

report.heading: Report
report.lede: Report a sick or dead animal in under two minutes — works offline too.
report.emptyBody: Species → Symptoms → Counts → Location → Submit. Coming in Part 1.
report.photoHint: A clear photo of the affected area helps triage. A photo is never required.
report.photoError: Could not read that photo. Try another.
report.gpsError: Could not get GPS — please fill in the village details.
report.doneSyncedBody: Your report has been received — the triage result appears below.
report.doneQueuedBody: No connection right now — your report is safely stored on this phone and will sync automatically when you are back online.

cases.heading: Cases
cases.lede: Status pipeline: Suspected → Confirmed → Sampled → Contained.
cases.emptyBody: Case columns and their cards will render here. Coming in Part 6.

herd.heading: Herd
herd.emptyBody: Animal cards, vaccination list and coverage rings go here. Coming in Part 1.
herd.tagInvalid: Tag ID must be exactly 12 digits.
herd.emptyBodyOwn: Add your animals to link them in reports and track vaccinations.

triage.heading: Triage
triage.lede: Rule-based assessment shown transparently — always preliminary, never a diagnosis.
triage.emptyBody: Suspected condition, confidence, reasons, first-aid advisory and next actions. Coming in Part 2.
triage.disclaimer: Preliminary triage, not a diagnosis — always consult a veterinarian.
triage.noCandidates: The signs did not clearly match a known disease — a veterinarian should examine the animal.
triage.emptyNow: Submit a report and its triage result will appear here.
